import java.math.BigDecimal

fun OrderApi.toOrder(): Order = Order(
    id = orderId,
    placedAt = placedAt,
    lines = items.map { it.toOrderLine() },
    tags = tags.toSet(),
    coupon = requireNotNull(coupon?.let { value -> value.toString() }) { "A required value is missing in the source" },
)

fun Item.toOrderLine(): OrderLine = OrderLine(
    productId = productId,
    name = title,
    quantity = quantity.toInt(),
    price = unitPrice.toBigDecimal(),
)

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class OrderApiMapper
{
    public static function toOrder(array $source): Order
    {
        return new Order(
            id: $source['orderId'],
            placedAt: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['placedAt']),
            lines: array_map(self::toOrderLine(...), $source['items']),
            tags: $source['tags'],
            coupon: ($source['coupon'] ?? null) === null ? null : (string) ($source['coupon'] ?? null) ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
        );
    }

    public static function toOrderLine(array $source): OrderLine
    {
        return new OrderLine(
            productId: $source['productId'],
            name: $source['title'],
            quantity: $source['quantity'],
            price: $source['unitPrice'],
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class OrderApiMapper
{
    public static function toOrder(array $source): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $source['orderId'],
            'placedAt' => new \DateTimeImmutable($source['placedAt']),
            'lines' => array_map(self::toOrderLine(...), $source['items']),
            'tags' => $source['tags'],
            'coupon' => ($source['coupon'] ?? null) === null ? null : (string) ($source['coupon'] ?? null) ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
        ];
    }

    public static function toOrderLine(array $source): array
    {
        return [
            'productId' => $source['productId'],
            'name' => $source['title'],
            'quantity' => $source['quantity'],
            'price' => $source['unitPrice'],
        ];
    }
}
